thread:
liz_support: Heads-up — ACME reported that their trial credits didn't change after several streaming completions. They get 200 / model output but balance stays the same. Customer provided request id `req_01G7xZ12` and example curl. Happened ~2026-02-27T15:03Z. Can someone take a look?

sam_oncall: I can check. Do we have the account_id and the exact timestamps? Also need the `stream_session_id` if they have it.

liz_support: Account: `acct-acme-9`. Timestamps: 2026-02-27T15:02:58Z -> 15:03:05Z. They used streaming generate with end-of-stream from client. Attached curl: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-ACME' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2","stream":true,"input":"..."}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream`

ops-bot: Automated alert: billing-processor v2.3 worker restart at 2026-02-27T15:02:50Z on node gpu-12.

deploy-bot: ledger-processor v2.3 deployed 2026-02-27T14:58:01Z (sha: abc1234).

sam_oncall: Looking at server logs for `req_01G7xZ12`... I see `stream_open` and multiple `chunk_send` events, but no `stream_close` or `session_end` event recorded. That would explain the missing debit: streaming debit happens on session finalization.

eli_billing: Confirming on billing side — there is a pending session entry for `req_01G7xZ12` with tokens counted in `pending_tokens` but not yet applied to the customer balance. The finalize worker reconciles on `session_end` event; if the event is missing the session stays pending.

liz_support: Customer insists they closed the connection — they saw EOF locally. Could be client dropped the final signal.

sam_oncall: Two options: 1) manual finalization for the session via admin tooling (fast), 2) dev fix: make finalize job time out after Xs and force-apply (will require a patch). For now I'll manually finalize and then we'll follow up with dev.

sam_oncall: (run) ```
redwood-admin sessions finalize --account acct-acme-9 --session req_01G7xZ12 --force
```

sam_oncall: Result: success. Applied debit of 1,430 tokens (estimated) and balance changed from 5,000 -> 3,570. Posting audit id `audit_20260227_001`.

eli_billing: I queued a compensating charge event and a customer-facing refund record if we overcharged after reconciliation. I'll also add a metric to surface sessions open >30s without end event.

liz_support: I'll update the support ticket: "We found the streaming session never registered a finalization event server-side; we manually finalized and applied the token debit. Your balance should now reflect the usage. We're also implementing a safety net so this doesn't recur."

sam_oncall: Filing follow-up ticket: ENG-9987 — "ledger-processor: add finalize-on-timeout for orphaned streaming sessions". Assigning to eng-runtime.

eli_billing: For postmortem: root cause appears to be a race where the deploy at 14:58 caused a brief window where acknowledgements from the worker were lost when it restarted. Worker restart + in-flight streaming close event can get missed. We'll add idempotent end-event handling and a periodic reconciliation job.

liz_support: Customer updated, confirmed balance updated and is fine with manual fix. Closing thread after we get ENG-9987 tracked. :white_check_mark:

sam_oncall: Thanks team. Marking resolved in Slack and added incident tag `billing-small-regen`. :thumbsup:

eli_billing: Doing a retro note and will attach logs to ENG-9987. :memo:
